🐍 Snake

Eat, grow, and don’t hit the furniture. One hundred points clears the board.

Play fills the screen. Escape brings you back here.

Snake

You are a line that grows. One hundred points clears the board.

Start

Return leaves the title. R, after a win or a crash, starts again and skips the title.

The field

Arrows or WASD turn. You cannot reverse into yourself. The apple is worth 10. Every 50 points the tick gets shorter, down to a floor where it will not get any faster.

The field is not empty. Cactus, rock, bomb, skull, fire, and lightning sit on it from the start. Running into one of them is the same as running into a wall or your own tail.

Arrows or WASD. One hundred points wins. A crash ends it. R starts again.
